title: adaptor.json
body:
{
  "version": "schemaxis.blender/1",
  "declarations": "schemaxis.adaptors.blender.adaptor:DECLARATIONS",
  "runtimeFamily": "5.2.3",
  "executables": [
    "blender"
  ],
  "execution": "background Blender; editable scene production, rigged motion, procedural nodes and verified frame/geometry outputs",
  "keywords": [
    "meshes",
    "materials",
    "modifiers",
    "rendering",
    "glTF",
    "view layers",
    "AOV",
    "Cryptomatte",
    "render bundles",
    "Freestyle",
    "simulation caches"
  ],
  "id": "blender",
  "adaptor": "schemaxis.adaptors.blender.adaptor",
  "executionCapabilities": {
    "modes": [
      "background"
    ],
    "nativeThreads": true,
    "gpu": [
      "CPU",
      "CUDA",
      "OPTIX"
    ]
  },
  "consoleCapabilities": {
    "authoredSessions": true,
    "multipleDocuments": true,
    "liveGeometry": true,
    "visualReferences": true,
    "geometryReferences": true,
    "imagePixelReferences": true,
    "imageReferenceRequirement": "a current native PNG preview; no inferred object identity",
    "nativeEditReverseSync": false
  },
  "consoleTemplate": {
    "version": "schemaxis.blender/1",
    "nodes": [],
    "scenes": []
  },
  "nativeExtension": ".blend",
  "consoleHooks": {
    "validate": "schemaxis.adaptors.blender.console:validate",
    "add": "schemaxis.adaptors.blender.console:add",
    "show": "schemaxis.adaptors.blender.console:show"
  },
  "liveSaveName": "scene.blend",
  "cliOptions": [
    {
      "flag": "--blender",
      "dest": "blender",
      "help": "Explicit blender executable"
    }
  ],
  "routes": {
    "schemaxis.blender/1": {
      "module": "schemaxis.adaptors.blender.adaptor",
      "workflow": true,
      "scheduled": true,
      "compose": true,
      "graph": true,
      "timeBatches": true,
      "schemaName": "blender",
      "acceptedArtifacts": [
        "geometry",
        "gltf",
        "table"
      ],
      "planIndex": 2,
      "schema": "schemaxis.adaptors.blender.schema:document_schema",
      "hooks": {
        "resources": "schemaxis.adaptors.blender.integration:resources",
        "provisionalResources": "schemaxis.adaptors.blender.integration:provisionalResources",
        "reusableInputs": "schemaxis.adaptors.blender.integration:reusableInputs",
        "validateHandoff": "schemaxis.adaptors.blender.integration:validateHandoff",
        "query": "schemaxis.adaptors.blender.integration:query",
        "inspectionSetup": "schemaxis.adaptors.blender.integration:inspectionSetup",
        "nativeInspection": "schemaxis.adaptors.blender.integration:nativeInspection",
        "acceptResource": "schemaxis.adaptors.blender.captured_inputs:accept_resource",
        "capturedInputSchema": "schemaxis.adaptors.blender.captured_inputs:captured_schema"
      },
      "schemaOrder": 1
    },
    "schemaxis.blender.render/1": {
      "module": "schemaxis.adaptors.blender.render_job",
      "workflow": true,
      "scheduled": true,
      "compose": true,
      "schemaName": "saved-scene-render",
      "referenceName": "blender-render",
      "expand": "identity",
      "acceptedArtifacts": [
        "scene"
      ],
      "graphEditing": false,
      "hooks": {
        "resources": "schemaxis.adaptors.blender.integration:resources",
        "provisionalResources": "schemaxis.adaptors.blender.integration:provisionalResources",
        "reusableInputs": "schemaxis.adaptors.blender.integration:reusableInputs",
        "validateHandoff": "schemaxis.adaptors.blender.integration:validateHandoff",
        "query": "schemaxis.adaptors.blender.integration:query",
        "acceptResource": "schemaxis.adaptors.blender.captured_inputs:accept_resource",
        "capturedInputSchema": "schemaxis.adaptors.blender.captured_inputs:captured_schema"
      },
      "schema": "schemaxis.adaptors.blender.schema:saved_scene_schema",
      "schemaOrder": 4
    },
    "schemaxis.blender.production/1": {
      "module": "schemaxis.adaptors.blender.adaptor",
      "workflow": true,
      "scheduled": true,
      "compose": true,
      "schemaName": "scene-production",
      "acceptedArtifacts": [
        "scene",
        "gltf",
        "geometry"
      ],
      "planIndex": 2,
      "schema": "schemaxis.adaptors.blender.production_job:document_schema",
      "hooks": {
        "resources": "schemaxis.adaptors.blender.integration:resources",
        "provisionalResources": "schemaxis.adaptors.blender.integration:provisionalResources",
        "reusableInputs": "schemaxis.adaptors.blender.integration:reusableInputs",
        "validateHandoff": "schemaxis.adaptors.blender.integration:validateHandoff",
        "query": "schemaxis.adaptors.blender.integration:query",
        "acceptResource": "schemaxis.adaptors.blender.captured_inputs:accept_resource",
        "capturedInputSchema": "schemaxis.adaptors.blender.captured_inputs:captured_schema"
      },
      "schemaOrder": 3,
      "referenceName": "blender-production",
      "graphEditing": false,
      "expand": "identity"
    }
  },
  "sections": {
    "render": "schemaxis.adaptors.blender.schema:render_schema",
    "saved-scene-render": "schemaxis.adaptors.blender.schema:saved_scene_schema",
    "scene-production": "schemaxis.adaptors.blender.production_job:document_schema"
  },
  "referenceSettings": {
    "Blender render": "schemaxis.adaptors.blender.settings:RENDER_OPTIONS"
  },
  "liveArguments": [
    "--background",
    "--factory-startup",
    "--python"
  ],
  "liveExecutable": null,
  "liveGraph": "schemaxis.adaptors.blender.integration:liveGraph",
  "capabilities": "schemaxis.adaptors.blender.capabilities:catalogue"
}
